release_notes: v9.8.33 (guid-bound HOTFIX) — CRITICAL fix over v9.8.32: the earlier GUID lookup used `ISINITIALIZE="Yes"` on the Company collection AND wrapped the request in SVCURRENTCOMPANY. On PCs with multiple books loaded, that combination made Tally rebuild its company cache on every quick-sync tick and eventually HANG / CRASH the tally.exe process (reported by Krishna Sales Corporation). v9.8.33 rewrites the lookup to use the exact same shape as v9.8.31's proven-safe `list_of_companies` (`ISMODIFY="No"`, no SVCURRENTCOMPANY, minimal field fetches), caches the result per-session so Tally is queried AT MOST ONCE per company, and dedupes the bind-endpoint POST per-session. The backend validator was also softened — a missing GUID on a bound sync is now a soft warning (not a hard block) so older Tally builds & first-cycle cache warm-ups no longer strand the customer. Hard block still fires on GUID MISMATCH (real corruption path). ALL v9.8.32 installs MUST upgrade before running against a multi-company Tally.
